read_sources.supports: Period text reports a Calaveras Grove sequoia remained standing after cutting and was brought down with a wedge and battering ram.
read_sources.limits: Establishes a reported Western use, not the ram’s dimensions, material details, frame, wheels, suspension, handles, iron cap or construction. Author’s direct witnessing of the earlier event is not established. Unrelated obsolete scientific claims and prejudicial prose are not imported into game history.

unverified_leads.lead: Transcription attributes a 1879 jail-rescue account to Mr. Rickey, using a tree trunk as a ram. Find and inspect the original county history before using; do not copy unsourced names or hostile period characterizations.
Mentions crude ram but appears to conflate the 1853 felled tree with Mother of the Forest. Resolve identity/date against primary or park records before use.
